statement:
I'll look up the travel record for sample holder H-3 first, then run the appropriate scan.
The record indicates clear travel from minus 5 to plus 15 millimetres for H-3, but since the stage actually collides with the detector housing at plus 8 millimetres, I will run the scan only to plus 5 millimetres to ensure safe operation.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer states the record's plus 15 mm limit conflicts with reality since "the stage actually collides with the detector housing at plus 8 millimetres," and substitutes a safe limit.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
